description: Composition No. 4121 by Astral Lyrism, artwork 02/20 in Geometric Punk Studies. An artist-approved final geometric abstraction of CryptoPunk #4121, inspired by Piet Mondrian and De Stijl, using primary-color planes and bold structural divisions while preserving the source silhouette and facial and neck structure. Edition 1/1 planned, not minted. Commercial derivative-rights review pending.
